metadata.executor: real `claude -p --strict-mcp-config --output-format json` subprocess, one per trial
metadata.notes: Run 2 came from evals/run-trials.sh as fixed on this branch and carries the subprocess's own duration and token usage. Run 1 came from an ad-hoc driver in plain-text output mode: its time_seconds is derived from artifact mtimes (validated against measured elapsed on evals 8, 9 and 10) and it has no token figures. Both runs were graded identically, from per-service call logs and a field-by-field diff of final stub state against the seed fixture.
